me2resh-apexyard-marketplace-audit-pack-.description: WCAG 2.1 AA audit — perceivable, operable, understandable, robust criteria. Deep-dive for /launch-check accessibility.

me2resh-apexyard-accessibility-audit.description: WCAG 2.2 AA audit — perceivable, operable, understandable, robust criteria. Deep-dive for /launch-check accessibility.

me2resh-apexyard-agdr.description: Browse / search / show / stats AgDRs across the portfolio — recalls "have we decided this before?".

me2resh-apexyard-analytics-audit.description: Analytics audit — SDK config, event naming, funnel completeness, dashboards. Deep-dive for /launch-check analytics.

me2resh-apexyard-approve-architecture.description: Record per-PR architecture-review approval for design-artifact PRs (required by the architecture gate). ONLY on an explicit per-PR architect "approved".

me2resh-apexyard-approve-design.description: Record per-PR design-review approval (UI merge gate). ONLY on an explicit per-PR designer "approved".

me2resh-apexyard-approve-merge.description: Record per-PR CEO approval and merge in one turn. ONLY on an explicit per-PR "approved" — never on umbrella "go".

me2resh-apexyard-audit-deps.description: Audit dependencies for vulnerabilities, outdated packages, and license compliance.

me2resh-apexyard-bug.description: Create a structured bug ticket (Given/When/Then scenario, repro steps, severity).

me2resh-apexyard-c4.description: Generate C4 L1 (Context) + L2 (Container) Mermaid diagrams from a project's codebase. Structurizr DSL escape hatch (--dsl) for L3+ component precision.

me2resh-apexyard-challenge.description: Invoke The Contrarian (Naqid) to steelman-then-challenge an idea, feature, decision, or plan — surfaces assumptions, failure modes, and alternatives. Advisory only; never blocks a gate.

me2resh-apexyard-code-review.description: Review a PR for quality, security, and standards compliance. Invokes the Code Reviewer agent (Rex).

me2resh-apexyard-codify-rule.description: Turn a review comment that caught a Rex-miss into a draft handbook entry — Y/N gate, source-PR footer, bucket-routed.

me2resh-apexyard-compliance-check.description: GDPR + ePrivacy audit — consent, privacy policy, data handling, right-to-deletion, DPAs. Deep-dive for /launch-check compliance.

me2resh-apexyard-debug.description: Hypothesis-driven debugging — architecture-first reading + evidence-before-fix. For bugs that resisted naïve fix attempts.

me2resh-apexyard-decide.description: Make a technical decision with structured reasoning and create an Agent Decision Record (AgDR).

me2resh-apexyard-design-review.description: Review a technical design / migration AgDR / feature spec for architectural soundness BEFORE the Build phase. Invokes the Solution Architect agent (Tariq) — the non-code analog of /code-review.

me2resh-apexyard-design-sync.description: Sync a local component library to a claude.ai/design design-system project incrementally — one component at a time, never a wholesale replace. Drives the DesignSync tool.

me2resh-apexyard-dfd.description: DFD with trust boundaries + data classifications (Mermaid + optional Threat Dragon JSON). Source-of-truth for /threat-model.
me2resh-apexyard-dfd.tools: Bash, Read, Grep, Glob, Write, AskUserQuestion

me2resh-apexyard-docs-audit.description: Diataxis docs audit — tutorials, how-to, reference, explanation; checks README, API docs, deployment guides, changelog, staleness.

me2resh-apexyard-eval-agents.description: Score a review agent (Rex/Hakim/Tariq) against a labeled PR corpus — ground-truth defect-set overlap, never a prose rubric. Headline metric is approve-precision.

me2resh-apexyard-extract-features.description: Six-axis Feature Inventory (routes / models / jobs / tests / UI / docs) — a "what we must preserve" spec for greenfield rewrites.

me2resh-apexyard-fan-out.description: Spawn N parallel Agent calls in one message (per-task agent type, worktree isolation, background mode).

me2resh-apexyard-feature.description: Create a structured feature ticket (user story, acceptance criteria, design notes) for a new user-facing feature.

me2resh-apexyard-feature-diagram.description: Per-feature Mermaid flowchart — routes / models / jobs / screens. Consumes /extract-features inventory.
me2resh-apexyard-feature-diagram.tools: Bash, Read, Grep, Glob, Write, Edit

me2resh-apexyard-geo-audit.description: GEO + AEO audit — `llms.txt`, `AGENTS.md`, AI-crawler robots, JSON-LD citation grounding. Sibling to /seo-audit.

me2resh-apexyard-handover.description: Onboard an external repo via a structured handover assessment + harnessability scoring across 5 codebase dimensions.
me2resh-apexyard-handover.tools: Bash, Read, Grep, Glob, Write, AskUserQuestion

me2resh-apexyard-idea.description: Capture a new product idea / feature concept / internal tool proposal to the ideas backlog (pre-triage).

me2resh-apexyard-inbox.description: Show every item across managed projects needing the user's attention — PRs, assigned issues, comments, blockers.

me2resh-apexyard-investigation.description: Create an investigation ticket + live-doc for sustained root-cause work (retros, bug archaeology, regression hunts).

me2resh-apexyard-journey.description: Self-contained HTML user-journey map (boxes/arrows with per-page modals) — preview between PRD and tech-design.

me2resh-apexyard-launch-check.description: Production readiness audit — 10-dimension go/no-go sweep (security, a11y, compliance, analytics, SEO, GEO, perf, monitoring, docs, behaviour-quality).

me2resh-apexyard-migration.description: Create a labelled migration ticket + matching migration AgDR — required by the migration gate.

me2resh-apexyard-monitoring-audit.description: Observability audit — logging, error tracking, health endpoints, alerting, runbooks. Deep-dive for /launch-check monitoring.

me2resh-apexyard-mutation-test.description: Mutation-testing sensor — language-dispatched (Stryker/MutPy/go-mutesting/mutant), milestone-cadence not per-PR, exit-3 graceful-degrade.

me2resh-apexyard-onboard.description: Guided first-run onboarding — capability tour, handover-vs-new-project branch, and a guided first win via a real filed ticket. The front door for a brand-new ApexYard fork.

me2resh-apexyard-orbit.description: Run the opt-in ORBIT planning lifecycle for one managed project without replacing ApexYard governance.
me2resh-apexyard-orbit.tools: Bash, Read, Write, Grep, Glob, AskUserQuestion

me2resh-apexyard-pdf.description: Convert markdown/HTML/BPMN to PDF (pandoc/md-to-pdf/wkhtmltopdf/bpmn-to-image), destination-prompted; graceful-degrades.

me2resh-apexyard-performance-audit.description: Performance audit — bundle size, image opt, lazy load, code split, caching, CWV. Deep-dive for /launch-check performance.

me2resh-apexyard-plan-initiative.description: Interview-driven initiative → milestones → tasks: per-milestone interview, a topo-sorted sequence, and optional filing of each milestone as a ticket with blocks/blocked-by cross-refs.

me2resh-apexyard-preflight.description: Check the local ApexYard environment before setup or when hooks fail.

me2resh-apexyard-process.description: Extract a business process from registered repos via 7-axis code scan + gap-targeted interview, then emit lint-clean BPMN 2.0.
me2resh-apexyard-process.tools: Bash, Read, Grep, Glob, Write, AskUserQuestion

me2resh-apexyard-projects.description: List all managed projects with status, branch, open PRs, and open issue counts — portfolio-level view.

me2resh-apexyard-prototype.description: Create a throwaway UX/demo prototype ticket (mockup / demo flow) — answers "what should it look and feel like?". DISCARD-by-default; same AgDR + coverage exemptions as /spike.

me2resh-apexyard-prototype-close.description: Close a prototype via the disposition gate — `--promote` files a [Feature] follow-up, `--discard` writes a memo. Mirror of /spike-close for throwaway UX/demo prototypes.

me2resh-apexyard-release.description: Cut an apexyard release — diff dev↔main, pick semver bump, generate CHANGELOG, open release PR, auto-tag on merge.

me2resh-apexyard-release-sync.description: Sync main back to dev after a squash-merge release — files a PR that makes the release squash commit an ancestor of dev, eliminating future merge conflict accumulation.

me2resh-apexyard-report-apexyard-bug.description: Report a bug in the apexyard FRAMEWORK itself (hook misfire, skill gap, rule bug) — files a structured issue upstream to me2resh/apexyard. Distinct from /bug, which files into your own project.

me2resh-apexyard-request-apexyard-featur.description: Request a new feature or enhancement for the apexyard FRAMEWORK itself — files a structured issue upstream to me2resh/apexyard. Distinct from /feature, which files into your own project.

me2resh-apexyard-roadmap.description: Update / create / reprioritise the product roadmap — add, remove, reorder milestones; renders a markdown table per milestone.
me2resh-apexyard-roadmap.tools: Bash, Read, Edit, Write, Grep, Glob

me2resh-apexyard-scaffold.description: Interview the owner, sized to the project's scale, and generate the project floor from a validated scaffold spec

me2resh-apexyard-security-review.description: Security-focused PR review for vulnerabilities and best practices. Invokes the Security Reviewer agent (Hakim).

me2resh-apexyard-seo-audit.description: Technical SEO audit — meta, OG, sitemap, robots.txt, structured data, mobile, CWV readiness. Deep-dive for /launch-check SEO.

me2resh-apexyard-setup.description: First-run framework bootstrap — 3 exchanges (describe stack → defaults → accept/customize) and the fork is configured.

me2resh-apexyard-spike.description: Create a hypothesis-driven, time-boxed spike ticket (Hypothesis/Budget/Kill Criteria/Disposition). Exempt from AgDR + coverage gates.

me2resh-apexyard-spike-close.description: Close a spike via the disposition gate — `--promote` files a [Feature] follow-up, `--discard` writes a memo.

me2resh-apexyard-split-portfolio.description: Migrate single-fork to split-portfolio mode (public framework + private portfolio) via gated destructive recovery flow.
me2resh-apexyard-split-portfolio.tools: Bash, Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob

me2resh-apexyard-stakeholder-update.description: Generate a weekly / monthly / launch stakeholder update — synthesises PRs, closed issues, AgDRs, and roadmap into a narrative.

me2resh-apexyard-start-ticket.description: Declare an active ticket so the ticket-first hook lets code edits through. Accepts `<N>` or `<owner>/<repo>#<N>`.

me2resh-apexyard-status.description: Project snapshot — git state, open PRs + CI, recent merges, in-progress issue. Use `--briefing` for compact form.

me2resh-apexyard-task.description: Create a structured technical task ticket (driver, scope, ACs) for tech debt, infra, refactoring, or non-user-facing changes.

me2resh-apexyard-tasks.description: Flat actionable task list across the portfolio with direct URLs — PRs to review, issues to triage, comments, failing CI.

me2resh-apexyard-tech-vision.description: Interactive author for the architecture vision template — target, gap, migration, anti-scope, cadence.
me2resh-apexyard-tech-vision.tools: Bash, Read, Grep, Glob, Write, AskUserQuestion

me2resh-apexyard-threat-model.description: STRIDE threat modelling — spoofing, tampering, repudiation, disclosure, DoS, EoP. Deep-dive for /launch-check security.

me2resh-apexyard-tickets-batch.description: File 5–20 structured tickets in one flow — shared-context Qs once, 3-Q micro-interview per ticket, then per-ticket `tracker_create` (gh/glab/custom).

me2resh-apexyard-tutorial.description: Standalone re-entry to the capability tour + full glossary — replays the roles/skills/gates walkthrough and all five terms any time, respecting depth mode. No /setup or /handover coupling.

me2resh-apexyard-update.description: Sync the ApexYard fork with upstream — preview, merge-or-rebase on a sync branch, walk per-version migrations.

me2resh-apexyard-validate-idea.description: Lightweight 5-question pre-spec gate between /idea and /write-spec — catches "this isn't worth speccing" in 10 minutes.

me2resh-apexyard-walking-skeleton.description: Scaffold a [Feature]-class ticket for the thinnest end-to-end slice — one trivial path wired through every architectural layer. KEPT and grown; full SDLC (NOT exempt like /spike).

me2resh-apexyard-write-spec.description: Write a feature spec or PRD from a problem statement or feature idea. Use when creating product requirements documents.
